goal: Determine which bounded graph presentation should extend the Body War Ontology Evidence Workbench so contexts can appear as understandable clusters, cluster cards or icons can act as portals, and Path can reveal a branch-like cluster view without inventing ontology meaning or losing exact predicates, direction, provenance, keyboard recovery, or complete-graph access.
context: The accepted candidate-local OEW focus scene already proves baseline 237 nodes and 231 edges, a first scene with 4 nodes, 0 internal edges, and 6 portals, deterministic portal pivot and Back behavior, and an automated A/B browser run. The latest visual-language research recommends a bounded business-context home, ontology-backed concept-role cues, redundant edge grammar, and truthful provenance, but its auditor blocked final approval on a missing legend witness and contradictory residue. The user now proposes clusters as meaningful areas, cluster icons as portals, and Path as a branch-cluster explorer. Research must compare external primary graph-visualization precedent with exact current source and ontology constraints, then produce evidence suitable for Invoke Define, Design, and Plan; it must not edit product source, ontology source, existing planning state, Inventory, telemetry, or external systems.
anti_bias_global: implementation feasibility versus graph-visualization evidence versus ontology-semantic fidelity versus novice navigation clarity

predicted_disagreements.statement: Hewitt tests current React Flow and OEW source seams computationally while Simon searches primary graph-visualization and HCI evidence empirically and historically; Simon exposes a locally easy but unsupported interaction, while Hewitt exposes a research pattern that cannot fit the accepted runtime.

Hewitt favors the smallest source-compatible cluster projection while Ashby formally rejects any membership, portal, or branch rule not owned by current ontology or presentation fields; Ashby exposes UI-invented semantics, while Hewitt exposes distinctions with no executable consequence.

Hewitt traces existing focus and Path state transitions while Bateson models the user's cross-context orientation and recovery loop; Bateson exposes technically valid navigation with a broken mental model, while Hewitt exposes attractive interaction concepts that require a second state machine.

Simon compares external compound-graph, semantic-zoom, overview-detail, and graph-map evidence while Ashby tests source-backed semantic non-collapse; Ashby exposes visual grouping that falsely becomes ontology, while Simon exposes semantically pure output that remains unreadable.

Simon evaluates published visualization effectiveness and accessibility evidence while Bateson evaluates information scent, prediction, branching, and recovery as one interaction narrative; Bateson exposes benchmark-friendly fragments that do not form a coherent journey, while Simon exposes an intuitive narrative lacking external evidence.

Ashby defines cluster, portal, context, relation, and branch boundaries from source semantics while Bateson tests whether those distinctions are perceivable and actionable to a novice; Bateson exposes invisible correctness, while Ashby exposes comprehensible labels that collapse distinct source meanings.

agents.angle: computational current-source feasibility for clusters, portals, and Path state
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and the relevant current-source rows from strategy-inventory-packet.json first. Then inspect the completed focus-scene Work Pack and receipts, accepted overlay and patch, current dashboard source archive, React Flow graph renderer, CustomNode, KnowledgeFocusPortals, PathFinder, store, gateway, and focused/browser tests. Do not mutate files. Map the exact current graph scope, focus, portal, Back, Path, filtering, selection, layout, node rendering, and edge rendering state owners. Determine the smallest source-compatible way to represent: (a) a bounded context as a cluster area, (b) a collapsed cluster card/icon as a portal, and (c) Path as a branch-cluster projection. Compare reuse of React Flow parent/group nodes, subflows, hidden nodes, custom nodes, viewport fitting, and existing focus projection; name exact source/test seams and every proposal that would duplicate state. Return exact paths, symbols/selectors, fixture inputs, expected states/counts, and implementation risks. Separate observed behavior from proposed behavior.

agents.angle: empirical and historical primary-source graph-presentation comparison
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and the presentation-related rows from strategy-inventory-packet.json first. Search external primary sources only: original or peer-reviewed graph-visualization/HCI papers, official React Flow documentation, official Cytoscape.js compound-node documentation, and authoritative accessibility standards. Do not mutate files. Compare at least: compound or clustered graphs, semantic zoom, overview plus detail, graph maps/regions, edge bundling, small multiples, focus-plus-context, and path/corridor views. For each, report which user task it supports, scale limits, direction/label recoverability, keyboard and forced-colors implications, and whether it supports a cluster card/icon acting as a portal or a Path-generated branch view. Cite every external claim directly, label design inference, and propose measurable Body War novice tasks without claiming comprehension.

agents.angle: formal ontology and presentation-semantics boundary for cluster membership and portals
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and the ontology-boundary rows from strategy-inventory-packet.json first. Then inspect the Body War business ontology profile, node index, nodes and relations, presentation graph and sidecar, adapter mapping, focus projection, and prior visual-language field model. Do not mutate files. Define source-backed distinctions among ontology context, business category, concept_role, presentation cluster, cluster membership, portal, crossing relation, full-graph scope, Path result, and branch. Determine which existing fields may derive a cluster, which groupings are presentation-only, whether one node may appear in multiple clusters, and how cross-cluster relations retain source predicate, projected direction, evidence, and authority effects. Produce a typed candidate schema and collapse tests. Reject invented cluster meaning, source_ref-as-identity, color-as-semantics, and any portal icon that hides its target or relation.

agents.angle: interaction narrative for orientation, cluster portals, branching paths, and recovery
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and the user-facing presentation rows from strategy-inventory-packet.json first. Then inspect the current Body War A/B captures, accepted portal and Back interaction, current Path control behavior, prior novice protocol, and relevant UI source. Use official component documentation and primary HCI research when making external claims. Do not mutate files. Model the full novice journey: arrive at a bounded area, understand what the area represents, recognize neighboring cluster portals, enter one cluster, inspect local cards and relations, invoke Path, understand alternative branches, choose a branch, and recover to the prior context or complete graph. Compare at least three interaction narratives and specify exact visible labels, information scent, focus movement, breadcrumbs/history, branch-state representation, empty/error cases, and observable tasks. Treat the cluster icon as a hypothesis, not a selected answer.

Reconcile all four explorer returns without erasing disagreement. Use the exact-binding evidence contract. Compare at least four coherent presentations: (1) collapsed cluster cards as portals into bounded context scenes, (2) spatial regions or compound nodes with semantic zoom, (3) Path as a corridor with branch clusters and reversible history, and (4) small-multiple context cards with an explicit full-graph escape. Also evaluate a minimal hybrid only if each part has one owner and one observable purpose. For every concept, state the user task, source-backed cluster membership rule, portal semantics, Path behavior, node-card form, edge/label/direction treatment, responsive/accessibility behavior, current owners, required new fields, exact selectors, Body War fixtures, and automated plus human witnesses. Select the smallest coherent prototype that can feed Invoke Define/Design/Plan, explicitly kill or defer alternatives, repair the prior legend selector and stale-residue defects if evidence permits, and never authorize implementation or ontology promotion.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Lakatos applies the precedent and existing-owner gate, accepting build-from-owned patterns even before a new Body War witness, while Gödel applies the non-vacuity gate and kills any cluster or branch interaction without an exact fixture and observable transition; each exposes the other's ownership deference or test overfitting.

Lakatos prefers reuse of current React Flow, focus, Path, and portal owners while Quine applies the definitional gate and rejects reused terminology that collapses context, cluster, portal, edge, path, and branch; Quine exposes inherited equivocation, while Lakatos exposes taxonomy proliferation without an implementation owner.

Gödel accepts only executable Body War selectors, state transitions, counts, and recovery witnesses while Quine rejects a passing witness that misstates ontology membership, relation identity, or direction; Quine exposes semantic false positives, while Gödel exposes distinctions with no observable consequence.

agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on precedent and ownership. Verify claimed external patterns in their primary sources and locate the current React Flow, focus-scene, portal, Path, adapter, layout, node, edge, gateway, and browser-test owners. Mark surviving ideas already-deployed, build-from-owned, or novel-attempt; precedent never emits KILL. Reject a new generalized cluster engine, layout subsystem, graph state machine, ontology grouping axis, or accessibility mechanism when an owned seam suffices. Return exact owner bindings and missing-owner residue.

agents.angle: non-vacuity attack with executable cluster, portal, and branch witnesses
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on non-vacuity. For every surviving presentation require a concrete Body War fixture and exact observable browser witness. At minimum test: bounded cluster home; cluster name/purpose/member count; one collapsed cluster portal with exact target and crossing relation; reversible entry and Back; Path activation; at least one branch and one no-path state; exact predicate and projected direction recovery; keyboard parity; focus restoration; forced-colors cues; responsive panel/viewport behavior; and intentional complete-graph escape. Require deterministic selectors, enabled states, counts/IDs, transition results, and failures. KILL any concept that passes only through adjectives or a static mock.

Attack the synthesis only on definitional soundness. Test whether area, cluster, context, category, focus scene, portal, crossing relation, Path result, branch, and complete graph are defined distinctly and bound to source or explicitly presentation-only rules. Ensure a cluster icon does not imply ontology membership, authority, completeness, or promotion; a branch does not change edge identity or source direction; and a Path projection is not confused with navigation history. Require exact field ownership, identity rules, direction semantics, fallback behavior, legend language, and no-authority disclaimers. KILL tautological, invented, or equivocal candidates and preserve typed residue.

After the strategist declares exact-binding evidence closure ready, write findings.md only. Lead with the selected cluster/portal/path presentation and why it is the smallest coherent successor to the accepted focus scene. Include the external presentation comparison, current-owner map, typed cluster and path model, cluster-card and portal contract, Path branch behavior, card and edge visual contract, repaired legend contract, killed/deferred concepts, exact source/test bindings, executable browser witness matrix, novice comparison protocol, and unresolved residue. Every load-bearing claim must cite an explorer return and source selector. Distinguish documented evidence, design inference, planned witness, and executed evidence. Do not authorize implementation or claim comprehension, accessibility conformance, ontology correctness, promotion, release, deployment, or production readiness.

Audit findings.md only against the frozen goal and exact-binding contract. Verify that the selected concept distinguishes presentation clusters from ontology meaning; makes cluster-card portal targets, membership, crossing relations, and authority effects recoverable; gives Path a precise branch-cluster state and no-path behavior; reuses current owners; keeps edge identity, predicate, presentation relation, projected direction, source direction, evidence, and provenance separate; provides a deterministic scene-local legend selector and browser assertions; defines keyboard, focus, forced-colors, responsive, and full-graph recovery witnesses; and leaves human comprehension pending. Approve or return one bounded writer revision. Reject implementation authorization, ontology promotion, deployment, production, or accessibility-conformance claims.
